node.statement: Let V be the vertex set of K. For each v in V, define the barycentric coordinate lambda_v: |K| -> [0,1]: on a simplex containing v it is the usual affine coordinate at v, and on a simplex not containing v it is zero. The formulas agree on common faces and are continuous on each simplex, so by the defining weak topology of geometric realization lambda_v is continuous. Hence U_v = {x in |K| : lambda_v(x) > 0} is open. Every x in |K| has finitely many nonnegative barycentric coordinates summing to 1, so some coordinate is positive and {U_v : v in V} covers |K|.
